subject: design/feature-draft-lock
statement: Prepare a ready draft on current mainline in a detached worktree, write literal contract Documents and records, remove working files in the preparation commit, and request operator review of that exact head; a later round reverts the commit.
intent: Make the approval request and landed records correspond to one verified draft digest without losing the drafting files on failure.
rationale: The detached worktree lets rebase, readiness, compilation, and memory gate finish before the author branch changes. The preparation commit carries the compiled records and deletes the source files together; the revert restores their bytes and digest.
fit_criterion: Preparation reruns readiness on moved mainline, adds only records and working-file deletions, passes the memory gate, and renders all rulings within the description limit; a round restores the exact draft digest; race, lint, and per-file coverage gates pass.
